description:
Every AI coding limit, on your Windows 11 taskbar.

CodexWinBar puts your AI coding-provider usage limits directly on Windows 11 taskbars — positioned opposite the clock — with per-provider session and weekly windows, reset countdowns, credits, an optional usage-pace projection, and live provider-status incidents. Supports Codex, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, OpenRouter, OpenAI Admin, z.ai, and experimental Cursor.
